# Account Hub spacing uses shared density tokens across related controls

Entry 2045 gives normal, compact and touch roots --hub-* spacing values. Account-step grid gap and body flex gap consume those tokens; remember-button margin is the negative body-gap token, so both change together. Frozen source retains that relationship and has moved width/max-width uses to logical inline-size/max-inline-size. Email/password bodies have narrower scoped limits rather than one global body width. Preserve each token’s role across its consumers when changing density; do not copy the historical physical width spelling as the current style. No rendered compact/touch, long-translation, zoom or click-region check ran. Static source and test inspection only. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending-single-browser-reader.

Scope: Account Hub density token and layout contracts.
